description: This file provides functions for checking and performing firmware upgrades on different hardware boards within the OpenWrt project, specifically handling various models from different manufacturers.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: A function that always returns success (0), indicating the image check passes.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs hardware-specific upgrade operations based on the board name, delegating to nand_do_upgrade or default_do_upgrade accordingly.
